Name: Quality Artisan Products
Author: Wingyl
TagLine: Makes input quality affect output quality!
Description:
Makes vanilla artisan good output quality match input quality, mead care about input honey flower type, and large milk/eggs give double output when processed.

Only affects vanilla recipes, requires Producer Framework Mod.

To install, just unzip into your Mods folder. 

You may want to delete any old versions before updating, there was at least one version where I accidentally included an entirely default machine config file.  


WARNING: Currently appears to have a soft incompatibility with the Producer Framework Mod example pack, Custom Producer Mod! CPM reimplements almost all the vanilla production rules in PFM, to act as a template; you probably don't need Custom Producer Mod in your mods folder but if you do somehow need both it and QAP please rename CPM to start with a letter later in the alphabet than Q. PFM will then prioritize QAP over CPM where they conflict.
